description: v0 shipped the governed core + a mock-mode builder. v1 makes the whole system COMMUNICATE end-to-end (UI <-> FastAPI <-> core <-> pgvector/LiteLLM, real mode, CORS, streaming) and adds a CHAT surface that consumes agents AND workflows (multi-turn, citations/tool-calls/denials, human-in-the-loop approval inline in chat). Everything stays offline-runnable by default (AGENT_STUDIO_OFFLINE=1) and honors the four seams. Prior plan archived in prd.v0.json.

chatContract.note: FIXED contract so frontend + backend build in parallel. tenant via X-Tenant-Id header.
chatContract.Conversation: { id, tenant_id, agent_id?, title, created_at, messages: Message[] }
chatContract.Message: { role: 'user'|'assistant'|'system', content, citations?: Citation[], tool_calls?: ToolCall[], denied?: string[], approval?: ApprovalRequest, ts }

endpoints.POST /agents/{id}/chat: body {message, conversation_id?} -> { conversation_id, message: assistant Message }
endpoints.POST /workflows/chat: body {message, definition, conversation_id?} -> assistant Message OR Message.approval set when a human_approval step pauses
endpoints.POST /conversations/{id}/resume: body {run_id, approved} -> assistant Message (continues the workflow to completion or reject)

acceptanceCriteria: Stand up the real stack: docker compose db (pgvector) + uvicorn api + vite builder (VITE_USE_MOCKS=0)
Map EVERY builder API call (builder/src/lib/api.ts) to its FastAPI route; confirm request/response shapes match (note the ingest {documents} wrapper, run {message}, workflow {definition})
Exercise create->publish->version->rollback->run and workflow run->resume against the LIVE api (curl or a script), record actual outputs
docs/e2e-audit.md: a table of UI action -> endpoint -> status (works / gap), plus the concrete gaps v1 closes (CORS, chat, streaming, real-mode)
No code changes required beyond the audit doc; ruff clean
userStories.notes: Grounds the plan. Reference: API routers already cover agents CRUD/publish/versions/rollback/run, ingest, workflows run/resume.

userStories.title: Conversations + multi-turn agent chat (+ SSE streaming)
userStories.description: As a user, I hold a multi-turn conversation with an agent that remembers history and returns citations/tool-calls/denials.
acceptanceCriteria: core/chat/ (or api/chat): a tenant-scoped ConversationStore (in-memory default; JSON-backed like manifest json_store) holding Conversation/Message per the chatContract

POST /agents/{id}/chat: appends the user message, runs the agent via LangGraphAgentRuntime with prior history as context (respect manifest.memory), returns the assistant Message (content + citations + tool_calls + denied) and conversation_id
POST /agents/{id}/chat/stream: Server-Sent Events streaming assistant tokens then a final done event with the full Message; offline echo streams deterministically
GET /conversations and GET /conversations/{id} (tenant-scoped)
Governance preserved: model/tool denials from the run surface on the assistant Message; tenant threaded
TestClient tests offline: two-turn chat keeps history; a denied tool shows in the message; SSE endpoint yields token events then done; conversations list/get
ruff clean, pytest green offline; follow the FIXED chatContract exactly
userStories.notes: Heart of the chat feature. Build on runtime + seams; do not change core contracts. Keep offline-first.

userStories.title: Workflow-driven chat (consume workflows, HITL approval inline)
userStories.description: As a user, a chat can run an agent WORKFLOW; when it pauses for human approval, the chat shows an approval prompt I can approve/reject to continue.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /workflows/chat: body {message, definition, conversation_id?}; starts the workflow (LangGraphWorkflowEngine) seeded by the message; if it pauses at human_approval, returns an assistant Message with approval = {run_id, pending_step}
POST /conversations/{id}/resume: body {run_id, approved}; resumes the workflow, appends the resulting assistant Message (COMPLETED output or rejected note), marks the prior approval resolved

Reuses the ConversationStore from V1-003 contract (coordinate on the same Conversation/Message shape); does NOT duplicate it — depends on V1-003 being merged first if needed, else defines a thin shared module both import
Governance + tenant preserved through start/resume
TestClient tests offline: a workflow chat pauses with approval set; resume approved -> COMPLETED assistant message; resume rejected -> rejected message
ruff clean, pytest green offline
userStories.notes: This is 'chat que consome os workflows'. Sequence after V1-003 (shares ConversationStore).
